name: SAM.gov Contract Opportunities
notes: Best source for U.S. federal contract opportunity notices.

name: Grants.gov APIs
coverage: Federal grant opportunities, packages, and agency/applicant system-to-system workflows
auth: Some endpoints require Grants.gov API key
notes: Includes Applicant and Grantor API families.

name: Grants.gov Grantor API
coverage: Open opportunity package search and opportunity detail fetch
auth: API key may be required for secure services
notes: Grantor API includes search2 and fetchOpportunity documentation.

name: Simpler.Grants.gov API
coverage: Modern grants discovery and developer API roadmap

name: USAspending API
coverage: Award history, grants, contracts, recipients, agencies, spending analysis
notes: Not an opportunity source; use for award history, buyer/competitor analysis, and market sizing.

name: SAM.gov Federal Assistance Listings API
coverage: Assistance listings / former CFDA-style program catalog data
notes: Use for assistance program intelligence and eligibility mapping.

name: EU Funding & Tenders Portal APIs
coverage: EU calls, funding opportunities, tender portal integrations
notes: EU single entry point for funding and tenders.

name: Tenders Electronic Daily API
auth: Anonymous for published notices; API key for unpublished/manipulation endpoints

name: UK Contracts Finder API
coverage: UK public sector contract opportunities and notices
notes: Useful for UK contract opportunity ingestion.

name: UK Find a Tender API
coverage: High-value UK public procurement notices; OCDS release/record packages
auth: API key for some publishing functions

name: World Bank Documents & Reports API
coverage: Project documents, reports, procurement/loan context documents
notes: Use for development project intelligence and procurement context.

name: World Bank Data APIs
notes: Use as contextual data source for proposals and market analysis.
